name: media_cleanup
description: Automatic removal of unwatched media with interactive control panel
author: Plexbie
commands: /cleanup panel - Interactive control panel with clickable buttons
/cleanup config - Configure inactivity thresholds and notification channel
/cleanup exempt add - Exempt a specific movie or show from automatic cleanup
/cleanup exempt remove - Remove a cleanup exemption for a specific movie or show
/cleanup exempt list - List all media currently exempt from automatic cleanup
